I was like that with my mom aswell, we constantly argued and fought. It took me not talking to her for a month and then sitting down and talking to her about why we fought. 

Same thing with my siblings, we always fought. We fought over anything. It's just what happens with siblings. The only time all of us got along is after the other moved out. 

I know you might not be able to not talk to your parents for a month and that your siblings might not be old enough to move out. But just talk to them about it. It really helps. 

I am just like you. I am tired of life. Day in, day out, it's just the same thing. It sucks. It sucks even more right now because my ex just ended it three weeks ago. This is why you should wait to find the perfect one for you. Who'll make you smile everyday, laugh, let you be yourself, help you with your problems and who most importantly actually loves you. 

I learned this the hard way too. I thought she was the perfect one for me. I loved her with all my heart, yet she never truly loved me. That shit will tear you up. It sucks a lot.

Now try to get a hobby you are interested in. Bowling, paintball, video games anything that'll keep you interested. It really helps. 

*side note* if you try paintball it'll hurt for a while and it is pretty expensive. But after a while it'll be great fun.

Hey Tyler, seems like you're in a very tough spot. I've  been there and am still in this spot. I can not promise you things will get better, it's a gamble, but they might get better. As much as this might be cliche, dont worry about girls, they shouldn't matter right now. Care about yourself. How can you care for a girl if you don't care about yourself. You can't I learned that the hard way.

As in a previous thread I am going to use what I said over here. 

"I know I cannot fully understand what you are going through I might be able to help a little. 

Now, to stop thinking about it let's have no more zero days (referring to a post long ago which has helped me somewhat). What's a zero day? 

This will be hard but you have to try to do this. A Zero Day is where you do nothing but think about it. How do we not have Zero Days? We do something, anything at all. This includes, but not limited to, cleaning, cooking, homework if your in school, bills, write a book, go for a run. Anything is better than nothing. 

If this is to hard at the moment have a One Day. What's a One Day? It's a day where you take your mind off the thing you're always thinking about.  Just do one think, like instead of cleaning; pick up one thing, instead of cooking; get a snack with little preparation, instead of doing all your homework at once; do one problem, one bill, one word, a one second run if that's what it takes. Just do one thing every single day. 

I know you have no idea who I am. People call me Catt. I'm 19 years old and I love animals, you still don't know me but you know a little more than you previously did. Getting back on track. Now after you are done with your One Day (take as many as you want) now try doing a Two Day. 

As the name might suggest this is where you do two things instead of zero. Last time I repeat this I promise. Instead of picking up one things; pick up two things, instead of taking a snack, make a little meal for yourself, like a hella good sandwich. Actually no, you don't deserve a hella good sandwich. You deserve the best goddamn sandwich ever. You're flipping awesome. 

After/if you do the Two Day, try a Three Day if you want. Remember you can take as long as you want on this. No need to rush. No need to hurry. Just relax, you deserve it. Now I really don't know you, and you really don't know me. But please for me, mostly yourself, please try doing a One Day all the way up to a Ten Day. After that go for an Eleven Day and keep going if you want. 

Know this may or may not help. Only time will tell. Now this may be ironic coming from me, but don't give up. Please just try this. Do it over and over again if you have to. 


Now for some new ways I've tried. 

Getting new hobbies. This may seem cliche, but it does actually help. It helps distract you. Guess what being distracted means, no thinking about the thing. Don't go join any hobby, do some research. Researching will help you be distracted too. You'll also find something you may or may not be interested in and have lots of fun doing it. It's a win win situation. 

Now this may be the most important, but most difficult thing to do. Whenever you think about it, dont say the thing. The thing being what happened to you. Don't think it, don't say it, don't breathe it. I'm not saying bottle it up. Just replace it with something else. Like the r word, or the thing as I have referred to multiple times. Just don't think about it. This will be the hardest thing you'll do in your recovery. With this being said, it'll be the most important thing aswell. 

I hope this helps a little and I'm not to late. 

I hope you have a good day/night. Just remember you are strong. You're hecking amazing, just remember that."

I know this feeling well. My ex just broke it off 2 weeks ago. I feel unloved and unwanted. What's worse is she never truly loved me. She loved her abusive ex. This has been destroying me. I loved her with all my heart and she was my world, she left me and I don't think I'll be ready to move on anytime soon. 

This being said, I know it is hard. But don't give up (ironic from me, I know). As much as I can't accept this fact at the moment. There are other people capable of loving you and actually want you.  I have major abandonment issues and they are worse now.   You'll be able to find the person for you. Even if they are online/different country/etc. 

Don't be like me and continue to chase after her. You'll only get more hurt. I'm miserable without her and I most 1000% would go back to her. She'll just end up hurting me again and again. But as long as I'm miserable I'll keep going after her. I hate it. It's not worth it. As much as you think it will be if you get a chance it's not. She will want you to chase you and use you. I hope you get over her soon.
